judgment_calls.decision: Urgent on (active_condition Anaphylaxis), i.e. the probable diagnosis from the flowchart's 'Treat as anaphylaxis' endpoints, as in gold p20.
judgment_calls.alternatives: The header says 'urgent attention to the patient with possible anaphylaxis'; Urgent could hang on the possible pre-screen diagnosis instead, but that pre-screen is our construct and would over-triage.

judgment_calls.decision: Itching / Eruption with Sudden onset qualifier (gold p20 forms); 'generalised' not encoded, so rule fires more often than the page intends.
judgment_calls.alternatives: Generalized pruritus (finding) / Generalized rash (disorder) exist, but Generalized rash sits under Eruption of skin (disorder), not Eruption (morphologic abnormality), and would match fewer records.
